name: PIM-023
source:
"Since I will never be able to experience such emotions, sometimes I find myself being envious of that side of humans." 

A home care robot for socially supporting the elderly, also known as silveroid.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mvizlab.com/]Official Website[/url]]

[spoiler]She was the present that protagonist bought for his father's birthday after the old man retired from his work. Ever since she was taking care of his father in his stead.[/spoiler]
